chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Stepin Fetchit throws a brick at Herman Stark
summary: In Danny's first week Stepin Fetchit threw a brick that nearly hit Herman Stark.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Another time, Stepin' Fetchit was in his show. Remember him throwin' the bricks and nobody knew where Stepin' Fetchit found them bricks?
He threw the brick, and it almost hit Herman Stark. throwin' at Stumpin' Stumpy(?). It almost hit him.

He was kidding Stepin' Fetchit, and then Stepin' Fetchit found this brick and threw it, and ...(?)..., just missed Herman Stark. I just had joined the band. It was the first week. And they had this thing going, where Stepin' Fetchit almost committed a crime and he almost killed Herman Stark, and they had to get Stepin' Fetchit to calm him down. And Stumpin' Stumpy had to go and hide somewhere... Oh, it was somethin'.
